description: This is a Java interface defining the DashboardService with methods for managing dashboards, including CRUD operations, assignment to customers and edges, and retrieval of dashboard data.

classes.name: DashboardService
classes.description: Interface for dashboard management operations, extending EntityDaoService.

methods.name: findDashboardById
methods.description: Retrieves a dashboard by its ID for a specific tenant.

methods.name: findDashboardByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a dashboard by its ID.

methods.name: findDashboardInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves dashboard info by ID.

methods.name: findDashboardTitleById
methods.description: Retrieves the title of a dashboard by ID.

methods.name: findDashboardInfoByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves dashboard info by ID.

methods.name: saveDashboard
methods.description: Saves a dashboard, with optional validation.

methods.name: assignDashboardToCustomer
methods.description: Assigns a dashboard to a customer.

methods.name: unassignDashboardFromCustomer
methods.description: Removes dashboard assignment from a customer.

methods.name: deleteDashboard
methods.description: Deletes a dashboard.

methods.name: findDashboardsByTenantId
methods.description: Finds dashboards for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: findMobileDashboardsByTenantId
methods.description: Finds mobile dashboards for a tenant.

methods.name: deleteDashboardsByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all dashboards for a tenant.

methods.name: findDashboardsByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Finds dashboards for a tenant and customer.

methods.name: findMobileDashboardsByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Finds mobile dashboards for a tenant and customer.

methods.name: unassignCustomerDashboards
methods.description: Unassigns all dashboards from a customer.

methods.name: updateCustomerDashboards
methods.description: Updates dashboards assigned to a customer.

methods.name: assignDashboardToEdge
methods.description: Assigns a dashboard to an edge.

methods.name: unassignDashboardFromEdge
methods.description: Removes dashboard assignment from an edge.

methods.name: findDashboardsByTenantIdAndEdgeId
methods.description: Finds dashboards assigned to an edge for a tenant.

methods.name: findFirstDashboardInfoByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds the first dashboard info matching tenant ID and name.

methods.name: findFirstDashboardInfoByTenantIdAndNameAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds dashboard info by tenant ID and name.

methods.name: findTenantDashboardsByTitle
methods.description: Finds dashboards by title for a tenant.

methods.name: existsById
methods.description: Checks if a dashboard exists by ID for a tenant.

methods.name: findAllDashboardsIds
methods.description: Retrieves all dashboard IDs with pagination.

methods.name: findDashboardInfoByIds
methods.description: Retrieves dashboard info for a list of dashboard IDs.
